turn_1.query: What is the status of ORD-025?

root_causes.description: LLMIntentClassifier.classify() returns IntentResult without populating explicit_entities, defaulting to {}. AIOrchestrator receives empty explicit_entities, causing update_slots_domain_aware() to skip slot updates.
AIRouter.route() line 87 extracts active_order_id only from context_slots and discards product_id, return_id, and refund_id when invoking LLMIntentClassifier.
RAG route (line 113) returns early without calling update_slots_domain_aware(), leaving stale order slots intact when a product query is routed to RAG.
No formal pronoun / contextual reference resolution component exists. Implicit queries rely on ConversationContext slots, which retain active_order_id due to Pathways 1-3.

test_coverage_gap: Phase 13.2.4 automated tests ran with use_llm=False on STRUCTURED routes only. They did not exercise LLMIntentClassifier return values or RAG route slot update bypasses.
